Conversion of nvidia/Llama-3_1-Nemotron-Ultra-253B-v1 (EXL3 3bpw H6) faults with the following error:
`RuntimeError: The size of tensor a (49920) must match the size of tensor b (399360) at non-singleton dimension 1`

Conversion of Nemotron-Ultra around a month ago didn't have any issues. Reverting back to [addeaaa](https://github.com/turboderp-org/exllamav3/commit/addeaaaaa76f5d9f9fc28d7d3b9125244235173d) (version used for quanting at that time) seemingly helps to resolve the issue.
